shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright monolithic block
horizontal band-like divisions across the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, highly schematic relief on a massive upright block, and both include a discrete disc/oval motif and curving limb-like relief forms above a horizontal banded division, which is the most specific correspondence. However A depicts a horizontal register scheme of repeated arch-shaped signs, a zigzag band, birds, a snake and other creatures, while B depicts a single anthropomorphic body with head, symmetrical arms and a belt carried on the block itself, so the subject matter and its organisation differ fundamentally.
